text: Morin Cloudstalker is a tauren quest giver located on the road from Bloodhoof Village to the Great Gate in Mulgore.

__NOTOC__ Morgaine the Sly is a rare human who can be found in the house at Mirror Lake Orchard in Elwynn Forest. Even after the Defias Brotherhood's collapse, she seems to have remained loyal to them. Her respawn timer is about 25–30 minutes.

Morgan the Collector is a human found at the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch in Elwynn Forest. He is a member of the Defias Brotherhood and in charge of Defias operations in Elwynn Forest. He has a ring that provides clues about the connection between the Defias Brotherhood and the old Stonemasons Guild in Stormwind.
Moorane Hearthgrain is a tauren baked goods vendor located at the Crossroads in the Northern Barrens. She was present during the Legion Invasions.

Morgan's Plot is a small decrepit church with a graveyard and crypt located in Deadwind Pass. It can be found just behind Karazhan, and its graveyard serves as the respawn and spirit healer point for adventurers who die within the actual Karazhan instance. Lydia Accoste is found here. The chapel itself was once inhabited by two Unliving Residents, and there was a third patrolling just down the hill. Aegwynn and Cook are buried here, and Moroes and Medivh were before they were revived. Since the third invasion of the Burning Legion, the place is now inhabited by Restless Spirits.

__NOTOC__ Morgan Stern is a human quest giver located in Theramore Isle's inn in Dustwallow Marsh. Morgan was researching recipes for his uncle Angus Stern. It's unknown if he survived the Attack on Theramore Isle.
Morbid Dawn is a highly sought after two-handed sword. Both Warriors and Paladins appreciate its exceptional stat, and DPS values.
__NOTOC__ Moora is a succubus found in Shadow Hold in Felwood. She and Salia are servants of Shadow Lord Fel'dan. Andalar Shadevale wants them all killed.

Mor'zul Bloodbringer was a human quest giver originally located just west of the Altar of Storms in the Burning Steppes. He disappeared after the Cataclysm after being "displaced" by Blackrock clan orcs. He returned during the Burning Legion's third invasion seeking to help the Netherlord of Dreadscar Rift in summoning a wrathsteed as their class mount.
__NOTOC__ Moordo is a furbolg artisan leatherworking trainer located at Stillpine Hold in Azuremyst Isle.
__NOTOC__ Morae is a draenei artisan herbalism trainer located at Blood Watch in Bloodmyst Isle.
Mordresh's Lifeless Skull drops from Mordresh Fire Eye in Razorfen Downs.
Moorutu is a tauren master skinning trainer located at Thrallmar in the Hellfire Peninsula.
Elixir of Shadows is needed to acquire items for several other quests. This repeatable quest allows you to get more as needed.
More Obsidian Warbeads is the repeatable version of the quest Obsidian Warbeads (quest).

This series of quests starting with a simple delivery of supplies to an outlying camp, and ends with you running up against a quite potent foe: Morbent Fel. You will travel to Stormwind and the Wetlands to find what you need, during the course of this chain, but most of the action centers around Duskwood.
Mor'zul's Instructions is provided for Dreadsteed of Xoroth (quest).
The Morass Road was a path through the Black Morass before and during the First War. The humans of Stormwind usually kept to the road, not entering the swamp itself.
Morlann's Seal is an ring. It gives bonuses to stamina and intellect. This is Apprentice Morlann's ring.
Mordant Grimsby is a level 42 quest giver located at Swamplight Manor deep in the Quagmire in Dustwallow Marsh. His occupation is herbalist.
Morgom is found in Grizzly Hills. He was originally located at Hatchet Hills in the Ghostlands.
Mordant's Travel Tunic is a quest reward from Cleansing Witch Hill.

Mor'vek is a jungle troll that can be found in Un'Goro Crater. He offers Horde adventurers a series of quests, dealing with getting poisoned, collecting ravasaur eggs and materials, to acquire the epic Whistle of the Venomhide Ravasaur mount. After the Fourth War, he was visited by Rexxar and Zekhan. He told them how brutal life in Un'Goro is for everyone, even on raptors.

Mordle Cogspinner is a gnome quest giver located at the Fizzcrank Airstrip in Borean Tundra. He sends Alliance adventurers to gather Fizzcrank Spare Parts from The Geyser Fields, Scalding Pools, and other mechagnome-controlled areas in the Borean Tundra.
Moragg's Chestguard drops from Moragg in the Violet Hold on heroic mode.
Mootoo the Younger is a tauren located in the Borean Tundra.
__NOTOC__ Morah Worgsister is an orc quest giver located at the Sunreaver Pavilion of the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown. She was present during Death Rising.
__NOTOC__ Morbid Carcasses are only present at The Shadow Vault before it is captured by the Knights of the Ebon Blade.
__NOTOC__ The Mord'rethar Robes drop from the Devourer of Souls in the Forge of Souls on heroic mode.
__NOTOC__ Morgan Dayblaze is a blood elf blacksmith found atop Deathbringer's Rise when the raid defeats Deathbringer Saurfang. He will repair players gear and also sell a variety of flowers.
Mor'kosh, the Bloodreaver can be found inside the Tribute Chest after defeating Anub'arak in the 10-man version of Trial of the Grand Crusader.
__NOTOC__ Morgan Day is a human jewelcrafter located at Wintergrasp Fortress in Wintergrasp when the Alliance controls the zone.
More Dots! (10 player) is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating Onyxia in less than 5 minutes on 10-player mode.
Moraya is a jungle troll located in Darkspear Hold, on the Echo Isles in Durotar.
Morgan's Militia is an organization that seeks to reclaim Morgan's family's lost lands and establish their own kingdom within the Burning Steppes.
More Skills to Pay the Bills was a professions achievement rewarded upon obtaining 525 skill points in fishing, first aid, cooking, and archaeology.
The Moore clan, or Clan Moore, is a small clan of Wildhammer dwarves located in the Twilight Highlands. They ride ebon gryphons.

__NOTOC__ Mor'norokk the Hateful is the ogre mage leader of a group of Twilight's Hammer clan cultists who have taken over the Alliance gunship Llane's Oath. Stormcaller Mylra calls for the ogre's capture in order to question him on the whereabouts of the World Pillar. After adventurers beat him into submission, Mor'norokk feigns defeat, only to subdue them when they drop their guard. As Mor'norokk is about to drop the heroes from the ship, Mylra comes to the rescue, hanging the ogre himself from the rope. Afterward, Mylra dangles Mor'norokk above one of the ship's propellers in order to get him to talk. After he divulges what he knows, Mylra reveals he was never in any real danger, as her s
Dragon Soul= |-| Waking Shores= Morchok is the first boss to appear in the Dragon Soul raid. He also appears as a rare elite mob in the Waking Shores.
Morairania Horton is a Forsaken warlock trainer found in the Pools of Vision of Thunder Bluff, performing some unknown ritual with Jensen Thomasson and Delano Morisett.

Mor'shan Defenders are orcs and tauren defending the Mor'shan Rampart against night elven attackers on the border between Northern Barrens and Ashenvale. Some of them were wounded during the assaults.
Morbidius is the guard of the tomb leading to Morbent's lair in Raven Hill Cemetery of Duskwood. He dies shortly after his master dies.
__NOTOC__ Mordak Nightbender is an orc rare mob found south of Nethergarde Keep, right outside the Serpent's Coil in the Blasted Lands. She seems to be brewing something.
Morango is a troll vendor located at Bambala in Northern Stranglethorn. During the events of Rise of the Zandalari, he was poisoned but soon healed by Bwemba.
Morgrinn Crackfang is a rare terracotta warrior found in the Terrace of Ten Thunders, to the north of Tian Monastery, in the Jade Forest. He is a pandarian champion.
Mor'shan Caravaneer's Leggings are a quest reward from Mor'shan Caravan Delivery.
Morakki is a jungle troll quest giver located on the Echo Isles in Durotar. He is the leader of the Darkspear Watchers.
To contribute to this achievement, you must have 3 guild members in the same group to be considered a 'guild group' for scenarios.
__NOTOC__ Mor'Lek the Dismantler is a dire troll found in Zul'Gurub.
Moori is an owl located at the Celestial Court on the Timeless Isle. It belongs to Lyalia.
Mooska is a yak located at Niuzao Temple in the Townlong Steppes.
Mor'dul Tower is a lone tower in Frostfire Ridge. The Damaged Highmaul Artifact has cast a spell upon the tower slowing everything inside to a near halt.
__NOTOC__ Morakh Chillwhisper is an orc located at Shaz'gul and Deadwalker Pass in .

Morketh Bladehowl is a former Iron Horde blacksmith dedicated to creating the finest weaponry possible. Fed up with their lack of respect for his superior craftsmanship, he defects to Vol'jin's Horde and joins the player's garrison as a follower - provided Vol'jin's Arsenal has been built in Talador.

Morelan Vanyst, the nephew of Bolten Vanyst, is left as the regent lord of the Vanyst family when his uncle leaves on a campaign. Having lost his wife when she gave birth to their son, Morelan would become close with the wife of Tyrathan Khort as their children played together. Hearing and believing of Khort's passing in Pandaria, Morelan would join the Pandaria campaign in order to prove that he could be brave. His uncle, ever a schemer, was quick to use his nephew to further his ambitions. After Tyrathan Khort's efforts against the Zandalari, Khal'ak ordered Captain Nir'zan to discover his identity by attacking the Alliance and taking human prisoners. Morelan and a group of fellow soldiers

Moose mounts were first added to World of Warcraft late during the Warlords of Draenor expansion, though the majority of them are only obtainable from Legion content. They are available from several sources.
The Mor'gran Logworks is a lumber mill area under the control of the Iron Horde.

Morgl the Oracle is a murloc who rarely appears in the Heart of Azeroth, the shaman order hall, or in Deliverance Point on the Broken Shore. Morgl first appeared in Hearthstone as a shaman hero before being introduced in World of Warcraft.
Mordrethal is a nathrezim that appears at Legion Invasion locations.

__NOTOC__ Morheim is a vrykul village farmland found on the coast in eastern Stormheim. It was overtaken by the Bilgefin murlocs in the middle of night, overwhelming the vrykul. It was named after a vrykul leader.
Morjirn is a vrykul located on the cliffs in southern Stormheim. He is the head brewer of the Tideskorn, and harboring jealousy of Melba's skill, sent a band of raiders to kill her.
Mordvigbjorn is a druid in Bear Form located in Stormheim. His race is unknown, as when he dies, he retains his Bear Form. Given his name, it is likely a vrykul.
Mordis Ironwood was a blacksmith on the Wavestrider. He died defending the ship against the Hidden.
Mor'shan Watchmen are orcs manning the watch towers of the Mor'shan Rampart against night elven attackers on the border between Northern Barrens and Ashenvale.
The Mor'shan Caravan Cart is a wagon appearing during Mor'shan Caravan Delivery.

__NOTOC__ Mordoth the Hunter is a Void creature who appeared in the Grave-Prison of Zakajz. As members of the Knights of the Silver Hand and the Tyr's Guard defeated Void cultists who had infiltrated the Tomb of Tyr, unstable Void energies were released and caused Mordoth to arrive from the Void. When the Highlord retrieved The Silver Hand (artifact), the tomb began to collapse. Mordoth's subsequent fate is unknown, though its parting words were, "Your escape... means nothing. Will find you again...". Later, an adventurer, Watcher Koranos, and Travard of the Tyr's Guard used a titan console within the Tomb of Tyr to access Keeper Tyr's last memories, where they saw that Mordoth had been pres
More Like Win-dictive is about collecting a full set of Season 19 or Season 20 armor (including bracer, belt and boots) for one class.

Morbix is the brother of Charnas. They once were very close, but they haven't seen each other in more than a decade, a thing that Charnas admitted to Greydon Thorne when they met and talked about their brothers.
Moore Gryphon Riders are dwarves located in the Twilight Highlands.
Moore Gryphon Mounts are gryphons located in the Twilight Highlands.
Morel Coils drops from The Lichen King, a rare fungarian in a cave at on the Hillcrest Pasture in Stormsong Valley.
The Mordant Greatcloak was looted from Challenger's Strongbox.
Morlann's Other Seal is a quest reward from Direhorn Raiders.
Moris Criz is a gilgoblin located at the Imperial Gardens in Nazjatar.
Mor'shan Caravan Kodo is a kodo located in Northern Barrens.
__NOTOC__ Moriaz the Red is a Maldraxxi necromancer located in Torghast, Tower of the Damned. He is also seen in the Sanctum of Domination.
Mordretha, the Endless Empress is the last boss located in the Theater of Pain.
The Morbid Boneguard's Head drops from Morbid Boneguards at Glutharn's Decay in Maldraxxus.
Morbid Disciples are Maldraxxi necromancers located at Glutharn's Decay in Maldraxxus. They have fastened Panicked Necrorays to Bone Stakes.
__NOTOC__ Morbid Boneguards are boneguards located in Glutharn's Decay in Maldraxxus.
Morbid Ritualists are Maldraxxi necromancers located at Glutharn's Decay in Maldraxxus.
Morgan's Notes are located in the Vision of Stormwind. The author is the dead Morgan Pestle.
Morguliax is a rare elite maw guard located in the Crucible of the Damned in the Maw. He also rarely drops the Stygia-Etched Decapitator and the Ancient Elethium Coin toy.

Mor'geth is a Maw caster world boss located in Helgarde Keep of Desmotaeron in the Maw. While the world boss is active, the world quest Mor'geth (quest) is active and calls for the maw caster's death.
Moriaz's Spare Targe is dropped by The Tarragrue in the Sanctum of Domination.
Mor'geth's Gauntlets of Damnation drop from Mor'geth at Helgarde Keep in The Maw.
__NOTOC__ More Raid Consumables are handed out by Cap'n Placeholder during the Season of Mastery.
Morgu is a worgen located at the Serene Dreams Spa in Thaldraszus. He is a member of the Untitled Band.
__NOTOC__ Mordigan's Field Notes are found in Gorloc Shore in the Azure Span. They belong to Mordigan Ironjaw.
__NOTOC__ Mordigan's Flask is found in Gorloc Shore in the Azure Span. It belongs to Mordigan Ironjaw.
__NOTOC__ Mordigan's Boots are found in Gorloc Shore in the Azure Span. They belongs to Mordigan Ironjaw.
__NOTOC__ Mordigan's Pants are found in Gorloc Shore in the Azure Span. They belongs to Mordigan Ironjaw.
__NOTOC__ Morgg is an orc located in Gelikyr Overlook in Thaldraszus.
More Doors to Open concludes the Zskera Vaults quest chain. Pathfinder Jeb will offer this quest each week going forward.
Morchie's Distorted Spellblade drops from Morchie in Dawn of the Infinite.
Moose Flank drops from: *Red Furred Calf *Red Furred Cow *Red Furred Bull *Striped Bruffalon
Morchie's Timeworn Shoulderpads is an appearance unlocked through the use of Ensemble: Temporal Burdens.

Mortars are a type of siege weapon that resembles a cannon. They are operated by mortar teams. They were used extensively as siege weapons by the Alliance of Lordaeron during the Third War. Ammo is called mortar shells.
The Mossflayer tribe is a troll tribe located in the Eastern Plaguelands.
The Moss Covered Granite Golem was a Granite Golem hiding south of Lordamere Lake when Kael'thas Sunstrider killed him.
Morrowgrain, under the right conditions, exudes qualities like other herbs used in primitive curses. , Archdruid and Archdruid are interested in its qualities.

__NOTOC__ Mother Smolderweb is a crystal spider mini-boss found in Lower Blackrock Spire. She is notable for having been a quest objective, and currently as the guaranteed source of the Smolderweb Hatchling companion.

Morlos'Aran was once a great night elf settlement, long before the Great Sundering. It is located at the southern edge of Felwood. There are similar ruins located nearby, at Ameth'Aran and Bashal'Aran in Darkshore, Ordil'Aran in Ashenvale, and Tethris'Aran in Desolace. Once thriving cities, now these ruins only serve as a reminder of the golden age that was lost long ago.
Mossy Tumor drops from the following bog beasts in Teldrassil: * Timberling Trampler * Timberling Mire Beast * Elder Timberling

Mosshoof Coursers are stags found in Azshara on the north-eastern landmass and south-eastern landmass. Originally hailing from Felwood, they chose to leave that place when it was corrupted. They are naturally resistant to disease and poison. They wear the mightiest antlers in the known lands.

]] Mosshide Fen is a region in the eastern part of the Wetlands which has fallen under control of the Mosshide tribe of gnolls. Several of their camps dot the landscape, and their vicious leader Gnawbone commands his tribe to capture and eat any adventurers that they spot who are stalking through the marshlands looking for Dwarven Tinder.

__NOTOC__ Mother Fang is a rare venom spider that can be found in the inner parts of Jasperlode Mine in Elwynn Forest. She has a respawn timer of around 1 to 2.5 hours, but due to low player traffic in the mine, she spends much of her time alive.

Classic= |-| BfA= Mosshoof Stags are stags found in southwestern Azshara. Two dead Mosshoof Stags appear in the Gallywix Pleasure Palace during I Take No Pleasure In This. Next to them is a Pleasure Palace Waiter.

Motes of Air drop from the wind elementals in Outland. They can also be extracted from a Windy Cloud in Nagrand by an engineer using a Zapthrottle Mote Extractor. Engineers who extract motes often receive 3-5 motes per cloud. Ten Mote of Air may be turned into one Primal Air by right-clicking on the stack.
__NOTOC__ A Mote of Earth is a trade item. 10 motes can be combined into one Primal Earth.
A Mote of Fire is a small piece of pure fire. It can be found while mining or killing fire elementals, and is used both in alchemy and engineering, as well as for combining into Primal Fire.
__NOTOC__ Mote of Mana can be purchased for from: * in Netherstorm * in Terokkar Forest

__NOTOC__ Motes of Water drop from water elementals across various places in Outland. Motes of Water can also be obtained by fishing Pure Water pools. Also have a chance to be found in the fishing daily reward Bag of Fishing Treasures (Terokkar Forest). Engineers can extract motes from Swamp Gas in Zangarmarsh and the Steamvault using the Zapthrottle Mote Extractor. Ten Motes of Water can be combined into a single Primal Water. Dealers selling Motes of Water in limited quantities: *Dealer Najeeb at Stormspire in Netherstorm *Dealer Tariq at the Bone Wastes in Terokkar Forest
__NOTOC__ Motega Firemane is a tauren quest giver located in Thousand Needles. Before the Cataclysm, he was located at Whitereach Post.
Mossflayer Shadowhunters are forest trolls found throughout Zul'Mashar in Eastern Plaguelands.
__NOTOC__ Mosh'Ogg Butcher is a rare mob ogre found in Northern Stranglethorn.

.]] Armed with their innovative exploding shells, the stalwart mortar teams of Ironforge are capable of blasting apart enemy ranks from long range. These fearless dwarves are masters of explosive devices and relish in pounding fortified enemy emplacements to dust. Notably, they participated in the Third War.
Morogrim Tidewalker is the fifth boss of Serpentshrine Cavern in Coilfang Reservoir.
__NOTOC__ Morula is a draenei food and drink vendor located at the Refugee Caravan in Terokkar Forest.
The Moss Cinch is a leather belt that drops off of Aku'mai the Devourer in Blackfathom Deeps.
__NOTOC__ Mosshide Gnolls are part of the Mosshide tribe of gnolls who can be found in the Wetlands.
Mother Kashur was the elder shaman of the Frostwolf clan many years before the First War. Her spirit is located in the Spirit Fields in Nagrand and assists in the Hero of the Mag'har quest chain.
__NOTOC__ A Mote of Shadow is a small bit of shadow essence. Ten can be combined to form Primal Shadow.
Mortog Steamhead is a Broken reagent vendor located inside the entrance to Coilfang Reservoir in Zangarmarsh.
Motes of Myzrael drop from the following Drywhisker kobolds in the Arathi Highlands: *Drywhisker Digger *Drywhisker Kobold *Drywhisker Surveyor

Mortal Shots is a Hunter talent in the Marksmanship tree that increases the ranged weapon critical strike damage bonus of your special shots. It does not affect your chance to get a critical strike, but instead increases the damage that your critical strikes do. Note that it is an increase to the critical strike damage bonus and not a straight increase to the damage dealt by critical strikes. The talent is a prerequisite for Aimed Shot
Morta'gya the Keeper is a forest troll found at the end of the cave atop Jintha'Alor in the Hinterlands.
Morod the Windstirrer is a Broken quest giver located at the Ruins of Sha'naar in the Hellfire Peninsula.

The Moss-Twined Heart drops from Blackmoss the Fetid at Wellspring River in Teldrassil. The heart was wooden, and the moss reeked of corruption. When Rexxar visited Teldrassil, he saw it and likened it to the corruption once rooted in Teldrassil by Fandral Staghelm. The sickness of the heart could have been cured by Denalan, but he perished in the Burning of Teldrassil.
The Mortar and Pestle is provided as an objective for To Kill With Purpose. With seven Living Rot a Coagulated Rot can be made.
Moss-Covered Gauntlets are a quest reward from Oakenscowl (quest).
__NOTOC__ Mosh'Ogg Brutes are ogres located in the Mizjah Ruins in Northern Stranglethorn.
__NOTOC__ Mosh'Ogg Witch Doctors are ogres located in Northern Stranglethorn.
Mossflayer Berserker was an undead dire troll found in the Undercroft in Eastern Plaguelands.
Mosh'Ogg Lords are ogres found in the Mosh'Ogg Ogre Mound in Northern Stranglethorn.

Morridune was found in Blackfathom Deeps. He is a former member of the Twilight's Hammer cult and was locked away with Aku'mai for treason. After Aku'mai was defeated by players, he would come out and create a portal to Darnassus for members of the Alliance.

Mosarn is a tauren located in Thunder Bluff. He is a respected blacksmith, has several apprentices and crafts products in large numbers. The Earthen Ring awarded Krog with a set of armor crafted by Mosarn. He supplies the braves and the Grimtotem tribe in Dustwallow Marsh.
Mortwake's Tower, formerly Klaven's Tower (named after its rogue Defias master Klaven Mortwake) lies at the southeastern edge of Westfall near the river and north of the Dagger Hills.
The Morthis' Materials item is provided as an objective for Vanquish the Raven God.

.]] Morloch is a trogg champion who claims Irondeep Mine at the beginning of every Alterac Valley battleground. He must be killed in order to claim the mine for your faction. He is guarded by two randomly chosen Irondeep troggs, either an Irondeep Shaman or Irondeep Skullthumper.
Mosswalker Possesions spawns when checking the pulse of dying Mosswalker Victims for the quest The Mosswalker Savior.

Mother of Bambina—along with Thudder the rabbit, Flora the skunk, and Bambina—all frolic together through the woods just west of the Westfall Brigade Encampment. Occasionally a spawns and shoots Mother of Bambina, killing her. After Mother of Bambina dies, Bambina says "NOOOOO! Mother! We'll avenge you!" She then gains a buff entitled "Bambina's Vengeance", and proceeds to kill the hunter. A player killing Mother of Bambina or her friends appears to have no effect.

Mortuus first appeared as Foreman Mortuus at Warsong Hold in the Borean Tundra as part of the Warsong Offensive, sending Horde adventurers to free Warsong Peons captured by the Scourge. Following the Cataclysm, he received a promotion to the rank of Grand Executor Mortuus at the Forsaken High Command in Silverpine Forest alongside Queen Sylvanas. He expresses optimism that Warchief Garrosh's stance on the Val'kyr will improve.
Mother Tauranook is a taunka located in Taunka'le Village in the Borean Tundra.
Moteha Windborn is a tauren quest giver located in Grom'arsh Crash-Site in the Storm Peaks. He provides a replacement of Brann's Communicator should you lose it.

The Mosshide tribe is a gnoll tribe native to Wetlands and recently moved into Loch Modan. They once made off with eight ingots from the Ironforge Royal Treasury. They are founders of the Axis of Awful.

__NOTOC__ Mosswalker Village is the ravaged village of the gorloc Mosswalker tribe, located in the Lost Lands and south of The Avalanche in Sholazar Basin. During the war against the Lich King, all its residents fled or were killed by the undead Scourge when the Lifeblood Pillar fell, which allowed the Scourge to invade the region from Icecrown. Following the war against the Jailer, the brothers Bronzebeard reported that the village is still in ruins.
Mote of Flame is a passive buff that triggers from the trinkets Reign of the Dead (Horde) and Reign of the Unliving (Alliance).
Mortalis is obtained from the Argent Crusade Tribute Chest with 25-44 attempts remaining.
__NOTOC__ Mossy Rampagers are bog beasts found at Drak'Agal in Zul'Drak.
Motivate-a-Tron is provided for A Few Good Gnomes. It (supposedly) allows a gnome to concentrate on the speech and find the courage to join the army. No, not mind control. Not really...

Mossy Pile is a small fortified camp located just northwest of Fire Plume Ridge in Un'Goro Crater. It's here that a few goblins from Gadgetzan, while working with Marshal Expeditions, exploit the area for profit.
The Mortar Team Target Dummy is a Target Dummy that can be found in Dun Morogh Sometimes the mortar team consisting of Angus and Shorty will shoot after it.
The Mortar Team AdvancedTarget Dummy is a Target Dummy that can be found in Dun Morogh Sometimes the mortar team consisting of Angus and Shorty will shoot after it.
Mosha Starhorn is a tauren battlemaster located on the Hunter Rise of Thunder Bluff.
Mosshide Ears drop from the following gnolls in Loch Modan: *Mosshide Scout *Mosshide Basher *Sagepaw

The Moro'gai was a faction of Lost Ones that existed in the World of Warcraft beta but was never implemented into the game. A few NPCs existed who were associated with this faction. A noteworthy example is Ar'lia, who was apparently supposed to be summoned by a number of gems.
Mother's Flame is provided as an objective for Following the Young Home.
Morthrandor is a Customer Support MVP for the Latin American World of Warcraft forums.
__NOTOC__ Mosh'Ogg Bounty is found at in the ruins behind the Mosh'Ogg Ogre Mound in Northern Stranglethorn.
__NOTOC__ Morris Vant is a human blacksmithing vendor found in Hearthglen in the Western Plaguelands.
Mortal's Demise is the gateway into the Sulfuron Keep Courtyard, found just north of the Molten Fields. Baleroc guards the area from intruders.
, used to represent Mortal Coil in Hearthstone.]] Mortal Coil is a warlock class talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Howl of Terror.
The Mote of Darkness is dark energy used for the purchase of one item, the Crystalline Geode. The geode is sold by Dasnurimi in Dragon Soul.
Morning Breeze Lake is a large lake north of Morning Breeze Village on the Wandering Isle.
Mothwrangler Min is a pandaren at Silken Fields in the Valley of the Four Winds.
__NOTOC__ Mortbreath Skulkers are crocolisks located at Kea Krak in the Krasarang Wilds.
__NOTOC__ Mortbreath Snappers are crocolisks located at Kea Krak in the Krasarang Wilds.
Mortbreath Grotto is an underwater cavern at the bottom of Nayeli Lagoon in south-central Krasarang Wilds. It's home to Nahassa, the patriarch of the Mortbreath crocolisks.
Mosstide Crabs are crabs located off the coasts of the Jade Forest.
Mother Wu is a pandaren living in a small house in the Waxwood Forest of Jade Forest. She has prepared several Boiling Cauldrons, which contain stew for the students at the Tian Monastery.
Moshu the Arcane is a pandaren at Shan'ze Dao in Townlong Steppes.
Motherseed is a huge seed located at Rikkitun Village in Dread Wastes.
The Morrowchamber can be found underneath Kor'vess, accessed via an opening east of the tree. A large number of Kor'thik Battlesingers are channeling something in the center of the area.
The Motherseed Pit can be found between Rikkitun Village and Rikkilea in northwest Dread Wastes.

Motes of Harmony are semi-common Pandaria world drops. A set of ten can be turned in to a single Spirit of Harmony, which is a crafting ingredient that is also used as a currency to buy advanced level 90 PvP patterns. As an ingredient, it will automatically will go in any enchanting bag, herb bag, inscription bag, or leatherworking bag that may be equipped.
Motah Tallhorn is a tauren general goods vendor located at the Gates of Sothann in Mount Hyjal.

__NOTOC__ Morta the Wretch is a Forsaken located at the Xylem's Tower in Azshara. During the Burning Legion's third invasion, he became a member of Xylem's inner circle. When the adventurer confronted the corrupted archmage, he sent his apprentici to deal with them. When Morta was defeated, a shadow emerged from him and he came to his senses.
Moro Sungrain is a tauren trade goods vendor located in Camp Mojache in Feralas.

Moss-Covered Chests are found all over the Timeless Isle. Each chest can only be opened once. Chests found west and south of the Celestial Court (marked with a ) contain a few dozen Timeless Coins and have a small chance at containing a timeless armor token. Chests east of the courtyard (marked with a red ) hold a few hundred coins and have a larger chance at containing a timeless token.

Mossgreen Lake is a small lake immediately east of the Celestial Court at the center of Timeless Isle. The Cavern of Lost Spirits is a few hundred yards to the north-northwest, and the Red Stone Run lies east of the lake, past the broken bridge. Since the destruction of the Vale of Eternal Blossoms, Mossgreen Lake is the sole source of Jewel Danio.
